data.name: Kabir
data.gender_notes: Kabir is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root k-b-r, 'to be great' — kabīr, 'great'. Used in India through the poet-saint Kabir. Its root is Arabic k-b-r (ك-ب-ر). Kabir, the 15th-century Indian poet-saint. Kabir is a Arabic name meaning “Great; mighty; the great one”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kabir expresses “Great; mighty; the great one”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root k-b-r, 'to be great' — kabīr, 'great'. Used in India through the poet-saint Kabir.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kabir total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
